title: Detailed hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFD966'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#E8A33D'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glassGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#A8E6F0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5CC8DE'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- wooden top cap -->
  <rect x='20' y='6' width='60' height='8' rx='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <rect x='20' y='6' width='60' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#D98A3D'/>
  <!-- wooden bottom cap -->
  <rect x='20' y='86' width='60' height='8' rx='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <rect x='20' y='91' width='60' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8A4A12'/>

  <!-- glass body: top bulb (wide at top, narrow at middle), bottom bulb -->
  <path d='M26 14
           L74 14
           L74 16
           Q74 30 54 48
           L54 50
           Q74 68 74 84
           L74 86
           L26 86
           L26 84
           Q26 68 46 50
           L46 48
           Q26 30 26 16
           Z'
        fill='#1A2A3A' stroke='#5CC8DE' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- inner glass highlight (lighter shade for edge) -->
  <path d='M30 17
           L70 17
           Q70 30 52 49
           L52 51
           Q70 70 70 83
           L30 83
           Q30 70 48 51
           L48 49
           Q30 30 30 17
           Z'
        fill='#24404F'/>

  <!-- top sand (upper bulb) -->
  <path d='M31 18
           L69 18
           Q69 30 52 48
           L48 48
           Q31 30 31 18
           Z'
        fill='url(#sandGrad)'/>

  <!-- falling stream of sand -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='48' width='3' height='18' fill='#FFD966'/>

  <!-- bottom sand pile -->
  <path d='M31 82
           L69 82
           Q69 70 52 68
           L48 68
           Q31 70 31 82
           Z'
        fill='url(#sandGrad)'/>
  <!-- bottom sand top curve highlight -->
  <path d='M48 68 Q52 66 52 68 Q58 68 60 71 Q52 70 48 68 Z' fill='#FFEFA0'/>

  <!-- glass reflection streaks -->
  <line x1='35' y1='22' x2='40' y2='32' stroke='#D6F5FA' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='75' x2='40' y2='67' stroke='#D6F5FA' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- bottom cap detail dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='90' r='1.2' fill='#5A2E08'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='90' r='1.2' fill='#5A2E08'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='90' r='1.2' fill='#5A2E08'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='1.2' fill='#7A3D10'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='1.2' fill='#7A3D10'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='1.2' fill='#7A3D10'/>
</svg>
